text: July 20, 1969. Minutes before Apollo 11 touched down on the Moon, its computer started flashing alarms: *1202. Then 1201.* It was overloaded. But its software had been built for this: drop the less important jobs, keep only what matters. Houston said: go. *They landed.* The team behind that software was led by a 32-year-old: *Margaret Hamilton.* She died this September, at 90. Send this to a programmer.
title: The Code That Saved the Moon Landing 🌕✨
pinned: Who's the programmer you look up to? 👇
